moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Grok @Bot will research gifts that your friends and family would love and buy them
moments.why: Chillingly signals AI moving from advice to actual money-managed purchases—everyone’s imagining letting their bot buy gifts.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: The cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue
moments.why: Rare frank admission of AI economics—users were burning through usage, now limits are tighter and everyone's irritated.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Try asking Grok @Bot to make calls!
moments.why: Turns AI virtual assistant into literal phone-calling agent—wild new capability fans are buzzing about.

moments.author: Justin Jefferson
moments.quote: Long black leather trench coat walk-in sparked memes—garbage-bag vibes.
moments.why: Pre-game look exploded on X—play-style meets fashion, and fans are roasting the outfit hard.
